summary: Elmet Group Co. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing via Item 7.01 a press release and under Item 8.01 a Tungsten Concentrate Offtake Agreement among the company, its Elmet Technologies LLC subsidiary, Drakelands Restoration Limited, and Tungsten West PLC. Elmet will buy an annual target quantity of tungsten concentrate starting 2027, receiving at least 50% of qualifying Drakelands output until production minimums are met, with sixty-day exclusive DLA supply rights. The agreement runs through December 31, 2034. This is a commercial supply arrangement, not a special situation; watch for production and DLA contract execution risk.
